name: io.github.AMEOBIUS-space/web-check-mcp
title: Web Check MCP
description: Agent wrapper for Lissy93 Web Check — 31 OSINT checks as MCP tools + CLI. Zero pip deps, multi-base failover, parallel fan-out.

environmentVariables.name: WEB_CHECK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Web Check API base URL. Default https://web-check.as93.net/api with automatic failover to web-check.xyz. Set to self-host (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3000/api).

environmentVariables.name: WEB_CHECK_MAX_WORKERS
environmentVariables.description: Parallel check workers for multi-check runs (default 6).

environmentVariables.name: WEB_CHECK_MAX_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Max JSON chars per check payload before truncation (default 12000).
